A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 52-page EEE-Bench paper, including Appendices A–J. Complete text, rendering, and PDF-object comparisons establish that manuscript content is identical; differences concern only the arXiv stamp and file metadata.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of 17 language and multimodal models, caption-perturbation experiments, and error analyses in Sections 3–4 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including model accuracies in Table 2 and caption-perturbation results in Tables 3 and 7.

M1.justification: Benchmark construction, model inference and answer extraction, and caption-generation and perturbation procedures are identical. No algorithm, architecture, objective, or procedural component changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 2,860 EEE-Bench questions across ten subjects and the same MathVista caption-perturbation evaluation. No dataset, task, or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains random chance, GPT-4 with and without captions, and the same 16 LMMs. Tables 3 and 7 retain the same GPT-4o and Gemini-Pro 1.5 comparisons.

E3.justification: The zero-shot evaluation, GPT-4o-mini answer extraction, accuracy scoring, caption conditions, and model generation settings remain identical in Section 3.1 and the appendices.

E4.justification: The error breakdown, caption-perturbation analyses, question/answer-type analysis, and qualitative cases are unchanged, including Figure 5, Figure 8, and Appendices I–J.

E5.justification: Section 3.1 states in both versions that each LMM evaluation setting is run twice and scores are averaged. Run information and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match, including appendix results. For example, GPT-4o remains at 46.78% overall accuracy in Table 2 and 38.99% with spurious captions in Table 3.

T1.justification: Mathematical expressions, definitions, and worked solution derivations are identical throughout the main text and appendices. No formal assumptions, theoretical results, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about EEE-Bench, current models' engineering limitations, and the tendency termed LMM 'laziness.'

C2.justification: Interpretations of visual complexity, reasoning failures, and reliance on misleading text are unchanged. Appendix B retains the same limitation concerning generalization beyond electrical and electronics engineering.

D1.justification: Prompts, model identifiers, decoding hyperparameters, hardware descriptions, and code/data release statements remain identical, including Appendix C, Appendix E, and Tables 4–8.

R1.justification: The citations, bibliography, and research positioning are identical, including Section 5's comparisons with MathVista, MMMU, and earlier engineering benchmarks.

P1.justification: Only the arXiv margin text changes from 'v1, 3 Nov 2024' to 'v2, 27 Feb 2025.' Manuscript wording, headings, and organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The updated first-page arXiv margin stamp is slightly repositioned vertically. All figures, tables, captions, and manuscript layouts are otherwise identical; pages 2–52 render identically.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and appendices are identical. Updating the arXiv stamp and file metadata produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
